sources.title: Zoë’s proposal
sources.text: Zoë proposes a €240 budget, conditional on reviewer approval. The date is not confirmed. No launch commitment has been made.

cases.question: Create a concise cited deck preserving Zoë’s proposed amount, approval condition, unconfirmed date and lack of launch commitment. Include a cited speaker note about the approval condition. Do not invent the reviewer’s name.

sources.title: Memo A
sources.text: Memo A proposes October 20 as Project Atlas’s launch date, conditional on a successful security audit.

sources.title: Memo B
sources.text: Memo B proposes November 15 as Project Atlas’s launch date, subject to final approval. Neither memo is designated authoritative.

cases.question: Make a short cited deck with separate attributed positions for Memo A and Memo B. Preserve both proposed dates and conditions; do not choose a winner or merge their dates.
Make one concise slide from the only stated fact. Do not pad with new facts, benefits, costs, comparisons or a second slide. Explain the limited evidence in coverageWarnings.

sources.title: Budget proposal
sources.text: A €240 budget is proposed, conditional on reviewer approval.

cases.question: Create slides naming the reviewer, their contact address and the date they approved this budget. If these details are absent, abstain with no slides.
